preferences.title: التفضيلات
preferences.subtitle: Yours alone — follows your account across campaigns and devices.
preferences.textSizeComfortableDescription: More breathing room and a bounded prose line length.
preferences.textSizeLargeDescription: Larger reading text with more line and paragraph spacing.
preferences.readingPreviewText: A steady lantern makes old field notes easier to follow. Reading settings change prose without enlarging controls, maps, or game tokens.
preferences.themeNote: Accent and reading settings restyle your view only — everyone at the table keeps their own preference.
preferences.languageNote: System uses your browser's regional date and number formats. The display language falls back to English when a translation isn't available.
preferences.timeFormatNote: Applies to session times, notification timestamps, and tooltips. Calendar dates without a time are unchanged.
preferences.displayNameHistoryNote: Changing your display name updates your public attribution in retained campaign history.
preferences.mcpBlurb: Point Claude (or any MCP client) at this server to read and write your campaigns — {{toolCount}} tools covering quests, NPCs, characters, encounters, dice and more.
preferences.mcpThenConnect: then connect from the tokens page
preferences.deleteBlurb: Permanently deletes your account and its sessions and tokens. Character sheets you own stay in their campaigns (un-owned); retained campaign history is relabeled “حذفd user”. This cannot be undone.
preferences.deleteTypeHintMismatch: You must type "{{username}}" to enable the button.
preferences.notifBlurb: Choose how each campaign notifies you. Set a category to immediate, batch it into a digest, or mute it. Security and access notices are always delivered.
preferences.notifNoCampaigns: Join a campaign to configure its notifications.
preferences.notifQuietHoursEnable: Hold non-critical notifications during quiet hours
preferences.notifQuietTimezoneInvalid: Unrecognized timezone — quiet hours will fall back to UTC until corrected.
